remarks: This is it! Live by the water in this perfectly renovated condominium in an exceptionally run association. First level unit and ranch style: this home features two very large bedrooms featuring new carpeting and two full freshly renovated baths. Hardwood floors, wood-burning fireplace, modern and updated kitchen, washer and dryer, large dining area, and plenty of closet space. One assigned parking space and ample visitor parking. Pet friendly complex featuring a pool, clubhouse and amazing views of the Long Island Sound. Minutes from the train, downtown Stamford and I95. Unit is also available for sale fully furnished. A wonderful place to call home.
